notes.title: Update of Game to 1.1.4 (Update Notes)
notes.content:
Hello, Players!

We're excited to announce the release of version 1.1.4, packed with new features and key improvements:

New Features:
[*] Added a UI marker for boss rockets to indicate their target location.
[*] Reworked boss rocket behavior for better predictability.
[*] Nerfed the boss on all difficulties except Impossible.
[*] Polished boss movement along its path for smoother gameplay.
[*] Added an option to disable camera shake.

Bug Fixes:
[*] Fixed level selection issues when using a gamepad.

notes.title: Update of Game to 1.1 (Update Notes)
notes.content:
Hello,

We’re thrilled to announce that the game has been updated to version 1.1, bringing exciting new features and important fixes:

New Features:
[*]Achievements Added: Unlock milestones and showcase your progress!
[*]Level Completion Details: The level selection screen now displays the difficulty on which each level was completed.
[*]New Music Theme: Levels 7 and 15 now feature dedicated music track.
[*]Expanded Localizations: The game now supports German, French, Italian, Spanish, and Turkish.
[*]Cursor Improvements: The cursor is now locked within the game window in windowed mode for a smoother experience.

Bug Fixes:
[*]Resolved potential soft locks on Levels 13 and 14.
[*]Fixed issues with Joe's missiles during pause.
[*]Adjusted hint sizes for Portuguese localization.

Fixed potential visibility issues with dialog boxes in narrative scenes.
Thank you for your continued support—we hope you enjoy these enhancements! 🎮

notes.title: Update of Game to 1.0.4 (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
Hello,

We’re excited to announce that the game has been updated to version 1.0.4, featuring the following changes:

[*]Added option "Screen Percentage" to help improve performance on GPU from Intel
[*]Fixed checkpoints in Level 1 on Impossible difficulty
[*]Show arrow while in Joe

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the improvements!

notes.title: Update of Game to 1.0.3 (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
Hello,

We’re excited to announce that the game has been updated to version 1.0.3, featuring the following changes:

[*]Checkpoints have been added to Level 7 and Level 15.
[*]Difficulty names have been updated to better convey the game's challenging nature.
[*]Fixed issue with selection of Impossible difficulty(checkpoints are disabled), Previosly hardest difficulty was selected instead.
[*]Improved wording in the Russian localization for better clarity and accuracy.
[*]Added an option to disable blood effects, providing a more customizable experience.
[*]Fixed a collision issue with the puppet on Level 11.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the improvements!
